_about: 26 Nov 2026, his words: "when somebody goes through the tutorial, a person must always understand what is the aim of this game, how do I win, what causes me to lose... simple, and visual cues, as little words as possible... the words should be big". One card a game: pic, WIN, LOSE, HOW (a few big words each). Shown before the first lesson and from the pause menu (HOW TO PLAY). tools/aims.py writes it into each game.
